basics.name: Jesus Manuel Hernandez Zozaya

basics.headline: 8+ years building high-scale consumer products. Staff-level ownership across architecture, design review, and the people side of shipping.
basics.summaryCv: Staff Software Engineer with 8+ years building high-scale consumer products at Gigantic Playground, PayPal and AutoZone. Leads through both architecture and people - owning systems end to end, running high-level design reviews, mentoring engineers, and aligning stakeholders from product and design through director level.
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 8+ years building high-scale consumer products at Gigantic Playground, PayPal and AutoZone. I own systems end to end - from event taxonomy and data models through GraphQL layers and the client-side architecture on top of them. I lead through both architecture and people: running high-level design reviews, mentoring engineers, and aligning stakeholders from product and design through director level. Outside of that I founded and built Brokxr, a full-stack insurtech platform, from the ground up.

work.summary: Technical owner of the analytics platform, leading architecture, design review, and delivery for the Fleet Platform System.

highlights.text: Architected the company's first analytics platform from the ground up - event taxonomy, ingestion pipeline, data model, and reporting layer - turning open-ended business questions from leadership into a durable technical foundation.

Authored the high-level design and drove it through formal HLD review with engineering and business stakeholders, establishing the design-review bar the team now follows and de-risking scope before implementation started.

Owned stakeholder alignment across the organization - gathering requirements from product and business owners, negotiating priorities, and communicating tradeoffs and progress to non-technical audiences.

work.summary: Member of Technical Staff and lead on the Digital Wallet team, overseeing card management, bank linking, and fund transfers related operations for PayPal's 400M+ global user base.

highlights.text: Led the Digital Wallet team's integration into PayPal's federated super graph architecture, powering the next-generation iOS and Android app for 400M+ users. Served as team focal point across principal architects, directors, product, and design. Drove adoption of a server-selected components pattern that reduced data-fetching latency by 2x, guiding 20+ engineers and team leads through the implementation.

Engineered the GraphQL layer and Next.js UI flows for a confidential next-generation in-device wallet initiative targeting a tier 1 software company. Delivered the end-to-end card provisioning experience including security compliance flows with Visa and Mastercard, enabling users to add and manage cards within the device wallet.
Co-led the rebuild of PayPal's global card-add experience on web, delivering a plug-and-play architecture used across all markets with 2x performance improvement.
highlights.cvText: Co-led the rebuild of PayPal's global card-add experience on web, delivering a plug-and-play architecture.

highlights.text: Architected the client-side and API layer for Money Pools, a cross-functional fund-sharing product that drove +$30M in Total Payment Volume.

work.summary: Owned frontend engineering decisions for the Customer team on autozone.com - architecture of new features, release planning, and stakeholder communication.

highlights.text: Designed and developed with the customer team, the frontend implementation of the key products recommendation feature inside a product details page. This feature increased weekly sales by 20%.

work.summary: Built and enhanced complex frontend flows for autozone.com across sign in, create account, rewards program, and orders history, and led the profile page refactor - reducing code complexity, making it mobile first, and increasing load speed.

highlights.text: Refactored a whole suite of react components to use the hook pattern, reducing complexity, moving away from class components, removing boilerplate code, and reducing overall file size.

work.summary: Built custom UI interfaces and backend services for web-based applications.

highlights.text: Implemented and contributed to a proprietary React Component Library (based on Material UI) and integrated a complete proprietary Design System, which included a theme palette, images, and wording guides.
highlights.cvText: Implemented and contributed to a proprietary React Component Library (based on Material UI) and integrated a complete proprietary Design System

highlights.text: Helped improve the frontend development flow around code transpilation with webpack and linting enhancements for standardization.
